note: M4.1 game values, decided without the owner (asleep; listed for his review): a round passing within 4 m of a man adds up to 0.3 suppression (heavier rounds more: square root of energy over 1,700 J, between x0.25 and x2; half as much at 4 m as at 0 m); a round striking near him counts at the distance of its impact; a burst within 1.5 x its stun radius adds up to 0.8. Suppression fades 0.1 per second (tuned with the suppression lab: a fire team at 200 m pins the men it fires at within about 6 s, a machine gun within 1-2 s, at 600 m within about 8 s; one aimed rifle rarely pins). At 0.6 he is pinned (prone, does not move, fires at a third of the rate) until it falls below 0.35. Stress grows by 0.02 per second x suppression, +0.15 for a comrade falling within 60 m, +0.2 when his leader falls, +0.25 x severity for his own wound; experience damps it (x(1 - 0.6 x experience)), his leader within 30 m too (x0.7). Under light fire (suppression below 0.3) it fades 0.01 per second. Stress over 0.3 cautious, 0.55 shaken (fires at 0.7 the rate), 0.85 panicked (lies flat, does not fire) until it is back under 0.7. M4.2 (same terms): a man fires on his own at an enemy he sees within 400 m (rifle), 600 m (magnified sight of 4x or more) or 800 m (machine gun) — under the default rule 'return' only once his unit has been fired upon in the last 30 s (a cease-fire order holds until it is fired upon again); under fire (suppression from 0.1) and not covered from the enemy he knows, he runs to cover within 15 m (preferring a spot where he can fire over it kneeling), at most every 20 s; a man out of spare magazines or belts gets one from the nearest comrade within 30 m who has more than 2 (or carries them for him), handed over in 3 s. M4.3 (owner: panicked men cower; a broken unit runs back): a unit on the move that comes under fire anew halts and takes cover; an assault goes in two halves bounding 30 m at a time (one fires at the objective while the other runs, swapping when the runners are down, or after 40 s), the last 25 m all together; a withdrawal bounds back the same way, the halt covering towards the enemy; a unit breaks when half its able men panic: they run 150 m away from the enemy they know and rally once nothing has been fired at them for 30 s (stress x0.6). M5.1 standing rules (owner 2026-11-12): ammunition discipline stretches the time between shots or bursts x1.8 (conserve) or shortens it x0.6 (maximum); 'fall back' on contact withdraws the unit 100 m away from the enemy it knows. Surrender (owner 2026-11-12): a conscious wounded man who can no longer fight (whether or not he can still walk) gives up when an enemy he has seen or been told of in the last 10 s (decisions.contactLostSeconds) is within 50 m and no fit comrade (able, can walk and fight, not panicked or routed) is within 30 m; a panicked or routed man gives up when such an enemy is within 30 m; a fit enemy within 3 m takes a surrendered man prisoner; each man reconsiders once a second. When things are quiet (his unit not fired upon for 10 s), one fit enemy within 50 m who has seen the surrender walks over, takes the man prisoner and returns to where he was; he gives the errand up after 120 s. Game values from the owner's approximate distances, the same for every faction; 0 switches a rule off. Attackers (owner 2026-11-12, after M6.6): men of the attacking side, and men of any unit in an assault, do not give up when panicked or routed (they run back instead); a wounded attacker who cannot fight gives up only with a known enemy within 25 m. M7.2 mounting (game values, low): men reach a vehicle exit within 2.5 m and board one at a time per exit; a walk to the exit is re-planned when the hull has moved 3 m; two comrades load a wounded man lying within 5 m of an exit if two able men are within 30 m (owner Q25); boarding is complete when every able man and every loadable casualty is aboard, or 60 s after the first man boarded (300 s at most); men getting out land 3-8 m behind the exit; a withdrawing squad within 100 m of its vehicle gets back in (owner Q24); a squad aboard within 100 m of an objective it is to hold gets out; a man out of spare magazines may take 3 from a halted own vehicle within 30 m, standing within 5 m of an exit; a crew checks once a second whether a crewman must take over a fallen driver or gunner. M7.3 gunnery (game values, low, the same for every side): a crew picks a target once a second among enemies its men saw in the last 4 s or a comrade reported within 20 m in the last 15 s; vehicles first (score x0.3), then men firing (x0.5), nearest first; groups (two or more within 15 m) and men beyond 400 m get high explosive, a single man within 400 m the coaxial machine gun, a vehicle the armour-piercing round; the commander fires the gun when the gunner is out; laser rangefinder 0.5 % range error; halted, a ready belt below a quarter is refilled from stowage; no fire within 60 m of own men on foot; the turret returns to the front 20 s after its last target. Near misses of heavy rounds (12.7 mm and up) suppress up to 4x a rifle round (cap 2 before). Anti-tank (M7.4a, owner Q19/Q20, game values, low): new units fire Panzerfaust and RPG on their own only at enemy vehicles they saw in the last 6 s (men on foot look for vehicles every fourth scan) (vehicles and positions: also at enemies in houses and machine guns; hold: only on an order); range error 5 %, aiming error 2.5 mrad for a regular on top of the round's dispersion; no shot from inside a house unless breached or of at least 60 m2, nor with a wall within 2 m behind or a comrade in the danger zone behind; a comrade within 30 m hands over a rocket. Crews (M7.4a, owner Q14/Q15): a burning vehicle is left 2 s after the fire starts; it burns out (destroyed) after 120 s, its ammunition may cook off every 5 s (8 %); a burning vehicle smokes (8 m); men left inside a vehicle that is destroyed are burnt (severity 0.7-1.0). Reversing out (owner 2026-11-13, "make armour not back out of every fight"; game values, low): a crew reverses out only when penetrated (still mobile), disarmed, its commander panicked, or an enemy man on foot it saw is within 50 m and none of its guns can fire at him; held 15 s, then back to where it stood unless the reason was damage; a bouncing rocket and ordinary infantry fire are no reasons; a vehicle under a player's move or halt order reverses only when penetrated or disarmed. Covering fire (overnight pick 2026-11-14; game values, low, the same for every side): an ordered or drill fire task may end in cover (any obstacle, the ground) up to drills.suppressShortM 15 m short of the point, in the far half of the line, and fires into it at no more than one shot or burst per drills.suppressIntervalS 4 s (a drill's fire at a point with no enemy named likewise); a covering man takes an enemy he knows within drills.coverTargetM 60 m of the objective that he can hit (clear line, no comrade in it), the k-th man starting at the k-th enemy, else one whose cover he can reach, else the objective; every drills.coverRetaskS 2 s a covering man with no shot looks again and, once a bound (drills.sidestep), dashes 2-6 m aside to a spot that gives him one; a runner's bound end is moved aside (at most drills.laneShiftMaxM 10 m, on the side he starts from) to drills.laneClearM 1.5 m outside every covering man's safety cone; the runners of an assault bound go only once a covering man has fired within drills.coverFiredS 5 s, or after drills.coverWaitS 10 s (doctrine 'no move without fire'; 0 switches it off). Defence fall-back (overnight pick 2026-11-14; game value, low): a withdrawal by drills.withdrawTogetherMen 3 able men or fewer goes back to its rally point in one leg, all together, instead of bounding (two men bounding left one lying alone to cover, and the drill took minutes; 0 = always bound).

soldier.note: Individual soldier AI (owner 2026-11-13, packages A-D; game values, low, the same for every side). A: a rifleman down to the magazine in his weapon keeps it as a close-defence reserve: he fires it (aimed) only at an enemy within 100 m, or within 200 m whose unit is assaulting; beyond 200 m riflemen firing on their own fire at half the rate; a man keeps his own target until it is down or he has not seen it for 5 s, unless another scores better than 0.7 x the current one. B: a pinned or panicked man lying where the enemy he knows can see him low-crawls (the crawl movement mode) to the nearest spot within 8 m, not toward the enemy, where it cannot (at most every 10 s); a pinned or panicked man lying in the open (no wall, hedge, building or wood within about 4 m, not indoors) crawls to the nearest spot within 8 m hidden from where the fire comes from (the rounds cracking past him, else the enemy he or his unit knows), else to the nearest such spot or cover feature within 15 m (owner 2026-11-13), never toward the enemy; a pinned man fires back from where he lies; men going to cover or to the end of a move keep 5 m from each other's places; a man on foot within 60 m of an enemy mortar burst remembers the mission (for 90 s after its last burst): halted in the open (no wall, hedge, building or wood within about 4 m) within 35 m of it, he goes into a house within 30 m, else 40 m out of it, not toward the enemy. C: each man remembers the posture of his fire position (where a move, an occupy or a posture order left him: kneeling or standing at a window, lying in the open); once he is no longer pinned and his suppression has faded below 0.05 he takes it again; a man lying where he cannot see the enemy he knows rises to his knees to look (checked every 4 s) and goes down again when fired on; in a fight (the unit fired on in the last 30 s) idle men outdoors turn to face the enemy they know when he is behind their shoulders, and in a team of 3 or more the last man watches the rear (faceEnemy false switches it off, for labs); a squad on its way into a house does not stop on contact; a man with an anti-tank launcher who knows of an enemy vehicle he cannot see (heard, reported, or out of sight, within 20 s and his weapon's range) moves up to 30 m to a spot from which he could see it, at least 40 m from it, preferring its flank or rear, at most every 20 s. D: a man carrying hand grenades throws one on his own (at most every 20 s) at an enemy he knows (seen or reported in the last 30 s) within his throwing range — rising to kneel or stand for the throw as the distance needs — who is behind cover from him (not in his sight) or in a house, when no man of his side is within 10 m of that enemy and no comrade of his unit is already throwing; in the last 50 m of an assault the men on the move fire as they go, at the enemy they know near the objective, with 3 x their aiming error. Fire discipline (overnight pick 2026-11-14): a man firing bursts also holds his fire for a comrade in his safety cone up to 60 m beyond the point he fires at (the beaten zone of a burst; low); a halted man outdoors within 1 m of a man of his side on his level (the higher id moves) steps 2-3 m aside, checked once a second (low); a man raised above his fire position's posture goes back down when his next shot is 3 s or more away, when he reloads, or when no posture gives him a line of fire, and rises again just in time for the next shot, keeping each posture at least 1 s (low). Movement under fire (overnight pick 2026-11-14): a man on a walk or sneak leg whose suppression is at least decisions.seekCoverSuppression (0.1), runs the rest of his way, until 10 s pass without it (low; player orders too); hurryFiredOnSeconds (0 = off, low) would also make every man of a unit with a man under fire in the last that many seconds run (3 s cost the German mounted attack 17/40 -> 10/40 wins); drills.reactNeighbourM (25 m, low): a moving unit also goes to ground when another unit of its platoon within 25 m (centre to centre) comes under fire anew; otherwise only the unit whose own men are fired on reacts to contact.
